## Goal

What should be true when this is done, in one or two sentences.

## Acceptance checks

- [ ] A thing I can run or click to see it works

## Area

`area:<name>` labels, one or more, if the repo's AGENTS.md defines areas. Otherwise leave this out.

## Priority

None for normal. `priority:urgent` for a hotfix, `priority:later` to run only when the queue is empty.

## Verify command

`just verify`
